run_train_autoencoder: run the autoencoder training script with a config file and profile name
run_resume_training: resume autoencoder training from the last saved checkpoint using the resume flag
run_jit_script_autoencoder: compile the autoencoder encoder and decoder with torch.jit.script for faster inference
run_train_with_progress: train the autoencoder while logging progress images and evaluation outputs to a writer
run_train_with_stability_check: train the autoencoder with automatic loss stability monitoring and checkpoint reset
